secondary.usage: Product info, micro-copy, ingredient lists, technical specs

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[8vw] tracking-tighter leading-[0.9]

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous whitespace. Big, quiet moments. Optical alignment over geometric.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Slow, deliberate motion with elegant easing. Nothing bouncy or fast.

scroll_sequence.name: Hero Statement
scroll_sequence.layout: Product image is massive and centered. Tagline 'Clear skin. Fewer choices.' fades in around it.
scroll_sequence.animation: Scale up product slightly on initial load. On scroll down, product begins to scale down.

scroll_sequence.name: The Transition
scroll_sequence.layout: Product scales down, rotates perfectly vertical. Background darkens. The statement 'Skincare shouldn't be this complicated...' reveals.
scroll_sequence.animation: Background color lerp based on scroll. Text opacity and y-axis translation (fade up) for copy.

scroll_sequence.name: The Ingredients (Sticky)
scroll_sequence.layout: Product pins to the left side (or top on mobile). Ingredients text ('2% BHA', 'Hyaluronic Acid') scrolls up on the right side.
scroll_sequence.animation: Product remains `position: sticky`. Right-side content uses vertical scroll.

scroll_sequence.name: The Trust & Results
scroll_sequence.layout: Product subtly translates to the right. Stats ('94% fewer breakouts') reveal on the left.
scroll_sequence.animation: Product x-axis translation based on scroll. Staggered fade-in for the 3 key stats. Subtle blur effect on the product to shift focus to data.

scroll_sequence.name: How to Use & Outro
scroll_sequence.layout: Product fades out or drops out of frame. 3-step usage appears followed by FAQ and Footer.
scroll_sequence.animation: Product unpins. Sections flow naturally with subtle scroll-reveal on text.

components.typography: Use raw Tailwind classes for layout-heavy sections. Break away from standard card components.
components.faq_accordion: Use custom or headless accordion (Shadcn customized): no borders, large typography, simple plus/minus icons, accent color #9AA6B2 for hover states.

product_image.description: Matte black cylindrical bottle. Used throughout the entire scroll sequence.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as a single-page React app with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Only use the provided assets in /assets/.
Implement the Apple-style scroll-driven product reveal using Framer Motion's `useScroll` and `useTransform` hooks.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all interactive and key informational elements, such as buttons, accordions, ingredient items, and metric numbers.
Use Manrope for primary text, Courier Prime for data/ingredients.
Make the background color transition from #F2EEE8 to #1F1F1F seamless and tied to the scroll position of the global wrapper.
No generic borders or box-shadows. Keep it completely minimalist and premium.
